tools.name: token-counter
tools.description: Use when a user asks how many tokens a given text will consume, or needs to estimate prompt size before pricing a workload. Given text and tokenizer family, returns low/high token range and byte-level measurements.

tools.name: provider-cost-calculator
tools.description: Use when a user asks what an LLM workload costs on a specific provider/model, or wants to compare cost across providers. Given tokens per call and call volume, returns monthly cost plus a tier comparison table.

tools.name: self-host-breakeven-calculator
tools.description: Use when a user is deciding between API usage and self-hosted GPU inference at a given volume. Returns breakeven token volume, monthly cost comparison, and go/no-go recommendation.

tools.name: context-window-planner
tools.description: Use when a user needs to know whether a document plus prompt plus output fits within a model's context window, or wants a strategy recommendation (truncate/summarize/rag/chunk).

tools.name: quantization-calculator
tools.description: Use when a user is planning to quantize an LLM to fit on smaller hardware. Given parameter count and precision transition, returns VRAM requirement, speedup estimate, and approximate quality delta.

tools.name: fine-tune-roi-calculator
tools.description: Use when a user is considering fine-tuning vs prompt engineering. Returns training cost, monthly inference savings, months-to-ROI, and breakeven volume.

tools.name: eval-cost-calculator
tools.description: Use when a user needs to budget an LLM evaluation run. Given samples/models/trials, returns total cost, per-run cost, and parallel time estimate.

tools.name: observability-cost-calculator
tools.description: Use when a user needs to budget LLM observability tooling. Returns monthly cost at given request volume with retention adjustment.

tools.name: rag-pipeline-cost-calculator
tools.description: Use when a user needs end-to-end RAG cost estimation (embedding + vector store + generation). Returns monthly cost with breakdown and dominant-component identification.

tools.name: automation-cost-calculator
tools.description: Use for generic or non-agent recurring workflow platform billing across Zapier task billing, Make credit billing, and n8n execution billing. Use agent-workflow-cost-calculator instead when the workflow is explicitly an AI agent with app actions or MCP tool calls. Use agent-loop-cost-calculator inste

tools.name: agent-workflow-cost-calculator
tools.description: Use for automation-platform/iPaaS cost of an AI agent workflow, including app-action fan-out and MCP tool-call accounting, explicitly excluding LLM token spend. Use automation-cost-calculator for generic non-agent workflow billing. Use agent-loop-cost-calculator for LLM inference/reasoning cost per

tools.name: agent-loop-cost-calculator
tools.description: Use for LLM inference/reasoning cost per successful multi-step agent task, including failure overhead and context growth across turns. Use agent-workflow-cost-calculator for iPaaS/app-action/MCP orchestration fees. Use automation-cost-calculator for generic Zapier/Make/n8n workflow billing.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "automation-cost-calculator" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
